records.description: 多元視野,追蹤世界 SY Horizon (SY 視野) 是一個專為現代人打造的綜合性平台，旨在幫助使用者一站式解決 日常生活中的各種麻煩，同時提供深度的思想與文化視野。 與傳統工具或單一資訊網站不同，SY Horizon 巧妙融合了「實用效率」與「人文思考 」： * 輕鬆解決日常麻煩：提供多钟实用工具，網頁無水印影音下載、生活避坑指南、單位換算與智能任務處 理等實用功能，讓繁瑣的日常變得井然有序。 * 多元視野與文學欣賞：匯集深度報告文學、古典文學與多元媒體內容，為快節奏的生活 注入人文清流。 * 開放創作者生態：我們誠摯歡迎寫手投稿，建立開放共榮的知識分享社群。 * 7天付費工具免費試用：新用戶註冊登入即可解鎖全功能，親身體驗效率與視野的雙重升 級。 多元視野，追蹤世界。立即訪問 sylogs.com，開啟您的智慧數位生活新體驗！

records.name: Bid to Up
records.tagline: Bid to rank #1 and get a FREE DA 40+ Guest Post
records.description: Bid to rank #1 and get a FREE DA 40+ Guest Post with every bid. Outbid your competition to climb the leaderboard.

records.name: Custom Dolls Manufacturer
records.tagline: Custom Dolls Manufacturer,Custom Dolls
records.description: JianChuang is a Custom Dolls Manufacturer certified by ISO 9001:2015, If you want to Custom Dolls, Please Contact US.

records.name: SaySorry.in
records.tagline: AI-powered emotional communication for real relationships
records.description: SaySorry.in is an emotional communication and relationship-tech platform that helps people express difficult feelings when words are hard to find. Users can create AI-assisted apology messages, personalised Sorry Cards, AI Love Messages, Love Cards, Love Letters and interactive romantic experiences such as proposal games, Love Test, Love Mailbox and Love Tree.

records.name: Poof
records.tagline: Pay to delete your competitor. They pay more to come back.
records.description: A public wall of products. $10 puts yours on it. $20 takes someone else off - and they don't have to be listed already. Paste their URL, we put them on the wall and poof them straight back off, with your product's name and link on the tombstone. Signing is free. They pay $10 more to come back. Then it's your turn again, and the price only moves one way. Nothing happens to their real site. Real charges, public receipts, nothing paid out to anyone. The house keeps it. That's the joke.

records.name: Yattayo
records.tagline: A physical slider to-do board, faithfully rebuilt in 3D
records.description: Yattayo is a to-do list you can feel. Every task is a real 3D slider on an orange board — drag the knob, hear the ratchet click, and an "OK" stamp lands on it. Done. • Every task is a sticky note. Tap it and handwrite or type right on the paper • Swipe a finished note to peel it off the board • Spin the whole board around with your finger • Widgets show the real board — slide the switch without opening the app • iPhone, Apple Watch and Mac, synced over iCloud Free for up to 3 tasks.

records.name: Aximote
records.tagline: Your car data, finally in your pocket
records.description: Aximote brings the data from your car to your iPhone and turns every drive into something you can understand. Trips appear automatically with insights into consumption, charging, costs and driving efficiency. Customize a dashboard with 20+ vehicle metrics, compare trips and long-term trends, manage multiple cars, and keep one continuous driving history—even when you switch brands. No additional hardware required.

records.name: Tab Notes
records.tagline: Turn your browser new tab into a distraction-free notepad
records.description: Tab Notes turns every new browser tab into a distraction-free notepad. Capture thoughts instantly with rich text, tables, and syntax-highlighted code blocks, or sketch ideas using the built-in shape canvas. Works completely offline with local storage or syncs privately to your personal Google Drive with zero server lock-in. Access notes in full-screen tabs, via a quick toolbar popup over any website, and export totxt ormd anytime.

records.name: Construct Computer
records.tagline: Your AI coworker gets a computer. You get your day back.
records.description: AI workforce for solo founders and small teams. Any MCP or skill installs like an app, agents build the tools that don't exist yet, deployed and managed by the platform, shareable to the whole team, and any agent action that you like turns into a reusable workflow so agents spend less time thinking and more time doing.

records.name: MP4Transcript
records.tagline: Convert MP4 to timestamped transcripts and subtitle files
records.description: Convert MP4 to an editable transcript online with timestamps and speaker labels. Export TXT, SRT, or VTT. Start free with 15 minutes. Video to text made simple.

records.name: Custom Plush Stuffed Doll Factory
records.tagline: Custom Plush Stuffed Doll,Plush Stuffed Doll
records.description: JianChuang is a Custom Plush Stuffed Doll Factory certified by ISO 9001:2015, If you want to Custom Plush Stuffed Doll, Please Contact US.

records.name: QRSyncHQ
records.tagline: QR codes that stay editable after you print them
records.description: QRSyncHQ generates fully custom QR codes — logos, colors, dot styles — for links, WiFi, contacts, text and PDFs. Dynamic codes keep working even if you change the destination after printing. Free tier included, no card required to try it.

records.name: FyroDB
records.tagline: Redis-compatible in-memory database built in Rust
records.description: FyroDB is a Redis-compatible in-memory database written in Rust, focused on high-performance concurrency and memory efficiency. It supports the RESP protocol, major Redis data types and commands, and a lock-free concurrent architecture.

records.name: Codex Speeder
records.tagline: Less repo search, fewer wrong edits, faster Codex work
records.description: Help Codex find the right files, callers, risks, and tests before it codes. Local-first, built for Python and TypeScript, and measured 19% faster with 34% fewer input tokens in a controlled cross-file benchmark. $29 one-time.

records.name: E-CampusBridge
records.tagline: The Smart Gateway to Next-Gen Education
records.description: India's #1 school management platform — attendance tracking, fee collection, live GPS bus tracking, parent chat, report cards & 40+ modules. Free 14-day trial. Trusted by 6670+ students.

records.name: VintAssist
records.tagline: Vinted bot for automation, relisting, offers, messages etc.
records.description: VintAssist – Vinted Bot & Seller Assistant VintAssist is a Vinted bot and seller assistant for automation, relisting, offers, messages, and more. It is a Chrome extension that adds a closet panel directly on Vinted, so you can manage repetitive seller tasks without switching to a second dashboard. Relist listings, send offers to Vinted likers, message people who liked or favorited your items, bulk edit listings, back up photos, and run Autopilot — all from your signed-in Vinted tab.

records.name: Digital product
records.tagline: Digital product
records.description: Useful digital product for you

records.name: ChatLume
records.tagline: Shed light on your chats.
records.description: View your WhatsApp and Instagram chat exports for free. 100% private — your chats never leave your device. Works offline. No account needed.

records.name: findnearby.pk
records.tagline: Discover Trusted Businesses Near You - Pakistan’s
records.description: FindNearby.pk is a Pakistan-focused business listing and local discovery platform built to make it easier for people across the country to find reliable, verified and nearby businesses, services and professionals in just a few clicks. Whether you are looking for a restaurant in your city, a trusted salon, a nearby doctor or clinic, a home repair expert, an automotive workshop, a retail store, or a service provider, FindNearby.pk brings all of them together in one searchable platform.

records.name: GRC Bid
records.tagline: GRC Bid is a paid, public leaderboard. For GRC Vendors.
records.description: GRC Bid is a paid, public leaderboard for governance, risk, security, privacy, and compliance. It is built for software vendors, consultants, assessors, legal and privacy firms, training providers, communities, and independent practitioners.

records.name: The CFO Platform
records.tagline: 200+ finance tools, compared honestly, in one place
records.description: The CFO Platform helps finance leaders compare 200+ software tools across every major category — from accounting and FP&A to treasury and equity management. No vendor noise, no sales calls, no pay-to-play rankings. Just a clear, practitioner-built way to see what's out there and choose with confidence. Built by finance people, for finance people making real software decisions.

records.name: FSW Liquid Cold Plate Manufacturer
records.tagline: Liquid Cold Plate Manufacturer,FSW Liquid Cold Plate
records.description: Leading FSW Liquid Cold Plate Manufacturer. Friction stir welding for leak-free, high-pressure liquid cooling, internal flow channels & CNC machining. Inquire now!

records.name: Stowaway
records.tagline: Take the window seat on any plane or satellite in the sky
records.description: Flight trackers show you a dot on a map. Stowaway puts you in the seat. Pick any aircraft or satellite currently overhead and ride along, looking down at the real world passing below. The sky is physically based — real sun and moon positions, real stars — so the light matches what's actually outside your window right now. Share a link to any flight. Send your family the one you're on and they can watch out the window with you from home. Free, no signup, in the browser.

records.name: PersonaForge
records.tagline: AI characters that remember, adapt, and stay in character
records.description: Create and chat with AI characters that remember important details, react to evolving relationships, and understand the current scene. Build your own characters or start chatting instantly.

records.name: PawToolkit — Free Tools for Dog Parents
records.tagline: DogCare, Dog Tools
records.description: Calculators, health guides and more — everything a devoted dog parent needs in one place. Free, no sign-up required.

records.name: Qyven
records.tagline: See where your habits are taking you.
records.description: Qyven turns your everyday habits into one Future Self Score, combining nutrition, fitness, sleep, focus, and energy to show where your current lifestyle is taking you. Track today. See your trajectory. Build your future self.

records.name: Ask-China
records.tagline: Find the right train station. Understand the menu.
records.description: Ask-China helps first-time visitors solve two practical problems in China. Rail Station Finder starts from real places—not just city names—then compares nearby verified stations in English and Chinese before handing the chosen pair to official Railway 12306. Dining lets travelers scan a Chinese menu, understand visible dishes against saved food rules, and prepare a bilingual card for restaurant staff to confirm. It does not sell train tickets or replace restaurant confirmation.

records.name: Aurelia: AI Language Tutor
records.tagline: Learn to speak, not just study
records.description: Aurelia is an AI language tutor built around real conversation. Speak from day one, not after years of drilling grammar rules. Have open ended conversations with an AI that listens, responds, and corrects your grammar in real time. Say what you want, get feedback on what you actually said. Words and phrases from your conversations get saved to your personal flashcard deck. Aurelia's spaced repetition system brings them back at the right time so they stick long-term.

records.name: Plask
records.tagline: Have little ducks show how deep you dive on your Apple Watch
records.description: Plask turns your Apple Watch into a tiny aquatic theatre: pixel-art rubber ducks that dive when you do, your real depth on screen, and a duck or ten. With premium, you get sharks, the Loch Ness-monster, a castaway, surströmming, and more.

records.name: kanye.cloud
records.tagline: Ask Ye anything. He answers with a line he already said.
records.description: Ask anything. Ye answers with a line he already said. Retrieval only. No fake quotes.

records.name: TellPopeyes
records.tagline: the official customer survey
records.description: Turn your receipt into rewards with this Guide to the tellPopeyes survey, including step-by-step entry, age rules, timing limits, and reward tips.

records.name: StudentKit
records.tagline: A lightning-fast, ad-free calculator hub for students
records.description: StudentKit is a lightning-fast, privacy-first platform featuring over 40+ academic, financial, and engineering calculators. Built specifically for students to seamlessly forecast CGPA, track attendance, and solve complex formulas with zero ads, no tracking, and no sign-ups required.

records.name: Conversly App
records.tagline: AI-powered customer communication and automation platform
records.description: Conversly is an AI-powered customer communication platform that helps businesses automate conversations, engage customers, and drive growth. Connect with customers through WhatsApp, AI chatbots, voice assistants, and smart automation—all from one platform. Built for businesses across industries to simplify support, sales, bookings, and everyday customer interactions.

records.name: Whelk: Private AI Platform
records.tagline: Your hardware. Your models.
records.description: Existing local-AI tools are developer utilities or web wrappers. Whelk is a native iPhone, iPad, and Mac client for AI you run yourself, on-device with Apple Silicon or on your own servers over VPN. What stands out: any chat can be armed into a full agent work session in place, with live tools and approvals. Your models. Your agents. Your network. The trust model is the architecture, not a policy: no accounts, no telemetry, no cloud. Nothing leaves hardware you own. Free for individuals.

records.name: BooDoo
records.tagline: The baby tracker that explains what the data means
records.description: Track your newborn’s feeding, sleep, poop and growth in seconds. BooDoo turns daily logs into clear, age-adapted insights, goals and reminders.
